Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
1047 AM EST Thu Nov 5 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 7 PM EST THIS EVENING...

.REST OF TODAY...S winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts to 20 kt. Waves
2 ft. Isolated showers late this morning, then scattered showers
with isolated tstms this afternoon. 
.TONIGHT...S winds 10 to 15 kt...becoming SW 5 kt late. Waves 1 to
2 ft. Numerous showers and scattered tstms. Patchy fog. Vsby 1 NM or
less. 
.FRI...N winds 5 to 10 kt...becoming NE late. Waves 1 ft. Showers.
Patchy fog. Vsby 1 NM or less. 
.FRI NIGHT...W winds around 5 kt...becoming NW 10 to 15 kt with
gusts to 20 kt after midnight. Waves flat... building to 2 ft after
midnight. 
.SAT...NW winds 15 to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.SAT NIGHT...NW winds 15 to 20 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.SUN...W winds 15 to 20 kt...diminishing to 10 to 15 kt. Waves 1 to
2 ft. 
.MON...W winds 10 to 15 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft.  

Winds and waves higher and visibilities lower in and near tstms.
